name: spacetime-ydrive
description: A minimal, shared cloud drive powered by SpacetimeDB.

scripts.dev:db:maincloud: npm run generate && spacetime dev ydrive-axerq --yes --server maincloud --server-only --skip-generate
scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
